items.text: The contract preserves source-qualified public/original/permissive cases, unit-aware observations, active and friction state, gap and lift-off, iteration and tolerance basis, diagnostics, solver-maturity dependencies, explicit TBD thresholds, and the software-verification-only authority boundary.

verification.text: Validate the contract and review source parity, nonlinear behavior-category coverage, provenance and protected-content exclusions, unit and deterministic rerun requirements, diagnostic/result-envelope categories, retained solver-maturity and tolerance TBDs, and prohibited authority claims.
